title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
All positions in this record are paper signals. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record. 1 trade says nothing about a strategy. In testing the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise.

## Framing: paper signals only

Every line in this record is a paper signal. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record. The record tracks what the engines do on paper, not what a live account would have done. 1 losing trade does not invalidate a strategy, and 1 trade says nothing about a strategy. In testing the average winner was roughly +19%, so the early losses here are consistent with that distribution rather than evidence of a broken rule. A losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise. The record is descriptive: it states what the engines did, not what anyone should do.

## Open positions

htf-rsi-v007 has 0 positions open on paper. trend-daily-v005 has 0 positions open on paper. trend-daily-v006 has 0 positions open on paper. Across the engines, 0 positions are open on paper right now. The only open position is a NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026, which has been open since. That entry remains open because its exit rule has not been triggered. With 0 positions open in htf-rsi-v007, trend-daily-v005, and trend-daily-v006, the record is currently holding no other exposure beyond the NEAR entry. The paper-only framing applies here too: the NEAR entry at 5.896 is a paper position, not a real order. 0 positions open on paper in htf-rsi-v007, trend-daily-v005, and trend-daily-v006 means those engines have no paper exposure at this snapshot.

## Closed trades

v005 counts its live record from 1 October 2026 and v006 from 9 October 2026. The first live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. ATOM exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. The rule was exit below the 10-day low. The measurement showed the close at 1.703. The result was −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. That is the exit rule doing what it was designed to do, not a judgment on the strategy. The ATOM result of −17.9% is 1 closed trade and does not describe the strategy. The first live signal, an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close, remains the only closed trade with a named symbol in this record.

htf-rsi-v007 closed trades so far: 4, average null net per trade. 4 trades is a small count and says little on its own. trend-daily-v005 closed trades so far: 6, average -13.22% net per trade. 6 trades is a small count and says little on its own. The average of -13.22% over 6 trades is a paper average, not a live account return. trend-daily-v006 closed trades so far: 7, average -13.34% net per trade. 7 trades is a small count and says little on its own. The average of -13.34% over 7 trades is a paper average, not a live account return. A null average for htf-rsi-v007 means no net figure is recorded for those 4 trades. These are the closed-trade counts and averages as of the snapshot, and they are paper results only.

## Market filter

trend-daily-v005: the Bitcoin market filter is off. trend-daily-v006: the Bitcoin market filter is off. With the filter off, new entries are not being taken by those engines, which is why both show 0 positions open on paper. The filter state is a gate, not a forecast: it blocks entries while it is off and allows them when it is on. The filter being off is a measurement of current conditions, not a prediction of future prices. With the gate closed, no 20-day breakout entry can be taken, which is why 0 positions are open on paper in trend-daily-v005 and trend-daily-v006.

trend-daily-v005 closest to its 20-day breakout:
- TRXUSDT is 12.91% below its high
- AVAXUSDT is 21.13% below its high
- XLMUSDT is 21.40% below its high

trend-daily-v006 closest to its 20-day breakout:
- JUPUSDT is 12.39% below its high
- TRXUSDT is 12.91% below its high
- AVAXUSDT is 21.13% below its high

These percentages measure how far each symbol is from triggering a 20-day breakout entry. None of them is at 0, so no breakout entry has fired. The 20-day breakout is the rule; the percentage below the high is the measurement; the absence of 0 means no entry has triggered. TRXUSDT appears in both lists at 12.91% below its high. AVAXUSDT appears in both lists at 21.13% below its high.

## Where to check

The record updates continuously. This live snapshot was read at 2026-11-15T09:09:50.193Z. The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel. Because the record updates continuously, the figures here are a snapshot and not a final statement. The performance page, the signal log, and the channel status all carry the same figures, including the 0 positions open on paper and the closed-trade averages. The performance page shows the 0 positions open on paper. The signal log shows the ATOM entry at 2.066 and the ATOM exit at 1.703. The channel status shows the filter states and the closed-trade averages.
